jobs.description:
Sabena Engineering is a leading independent and international aviation solutions provider for civil and military operators.
 

Our capabilities cover the main aircraft types, including Airbus, Boeing, Lockheed, regional and military aircraft and rotor aircraft. With our unique and innovative solutions to both regular and complex needs, Sabena Engineering is all set to grow as a worldwide proximity partner, bringing its expertise wherever needed. SABCA offers a full range of services to the civil, space and military aviation markets and recently expanded into the commercial Unmanned Autonomous Systems market as an integrator of aerospace-grade solutions for the industry.
 

Sabena Aerospace & SABCA are part of a unique industrial ecosystem in the Belgian aerospace industry which is owned by Sabena Aerospace (holding company) and by the Société Fédérale de Participations et d’Investissements (SFPI/FPIM).
 

Are you ready to join us?
 

Your Main Responsibilities:
 

Reporting to the Head of Engine Services, you will be required to perform the following:
 
 

• Engine Incoming Inspection 

• Engine Storage, Humidity Checks and Humidity Corrections 

• Engine Preservation 

• Engine Boroscope inspection 

• Engine Boroblending 

• Engine handling, QEC removal and installation 

• Engine inspection at major module level, Inventory Checks and Lease Return Work Scope (LRWS) / C-Checks iaw B-rating 

• Engine Identification Plug TST/REP iaw C-rating 

• Replacement of external engine parts 

• Maintain and operate ES tooling 

• Maintain and follow-up of local products 
 

• Full understanding of ATA 100 system and working knowledge of interactions between AMM, ESM, CMM 

• Capability of reading, understanding and implementation of service bulletins and airworthy documentation 

• Ability to converse and understand English language at a high level 

• High level of reading and writing technical English is a must 

• High level of computer literacy will be required for daily tasks 

• Have the ability to work within a small team and act independently when required 

• You have a part 66 B1, B1/B2, B1/C or B1/B2/ C license or equivalent shop training/experience on CFM56 and/or V2500 and/or LEAP 1A/1B engines

Do you, like us, have an insatiable passion for the endless possibilities of the innovative Microsoft Power Platform, and do you get energy from helping customers optimize their business processes?  In a very short time, our Power Platform team has grown into a close-knit group of about 20 colleagues with different ambitions but a shared passion for the technology. Together, we help customers innovate faster: by quickly building modern solutions without complex code, creating smart integrations with numerous other systems, and delivering AI solutions that automate processes while generating real business value - something we’re proud of! Would you like to help drive our growth story and work on cutting-edge projects? 

• As a Solution Architect, you inspire and guide customers during their Power Platform journey and digital transformation. 
• Together with sales, you work on quotation requests, RFPs, and customer proposals. You translate customer needs into the right solution and present demos, workshops, and proof-of-concepts. Presales is an important part of your role. 
• During the project duration, you take the lead and give other consultants directions, while also working hands-on on tasks yourself. How else can you keep up with the rapidly evolving technology? 
• In short, you support the entire Power Platform journey from A to Z. 
What you need to succeed:
• You have in-depth knowledge of the different components within the Microsoft Power Platform, including Power Apps, Dataverse, Copilot Studio, and more. 
• In addition to the platform’s unique low-code development capabilities, you also have experience with governance and user adoption, hyperautomation, and more. 
• You have commercial flair and get energy from presales activities such as demos, workshops, and developing technical proposals. 
• Shaping Digital Together: together with various stakeholders, you strive for the best possible result. 
• You closely follow the latest developments around AI, Copilot, and the Microsoft platform, and you enjoy exploring how they can be used to deliver even more value to customers. You are also eager to share this knowledge with your colleagues. 
• You are down-to-earth and a true team player at heart. 
• You possess excellent communication skills in Dutch and English.

Day-Shift Sorting Operative
Looking for varied work in the clothing sector? As a full-time sorting operative in Zulte, you will help sort and distribute clothing.
What does the job involve?
• 
You sort second-hand clothing into different quality categories.

• 
You process the different materials correctly.

• 
You keep up the pace while ensuring your work is carried out carefully.

• 
You contribute to smooth collaboration with the team.

• 
Your attention to detail helps ensure the clothing is processed correctly.

This role is a good fit for you if you enjoy getting hands-on and working with a focus on quality.

• 
Sorting second-hand clothing into different quality categories is the kind of work where your attention to detail can really shine.

• 
You maintain a good pace, combining energy with care.

• 
You are comfortable with physical work and do not have a dust allergy.

• 
You can communicate in Dutch or English and enjoy working with colleagues.

• 
You are motivated and are looking for a long-term job.

jobs.occupation: Freight Forwarder Airfreight export - Late Shift
jobs.description:
As a Freight Forwarder Export Air, you will be responsible for managing your own shipments and coordinating the entire transport process from A to Z.

Your responsibilities

Manage daily customer service and maintain close contact with clients regarding air export shipments.

Create and manage shipments in the company's own TMS system.

Provide clear instructions to the customs team to ensure the correct preparation of customs documentation.

Communicate daily with the international network regarding shipment pre-alerts and quotations.

Ensure accurate invoicing and maintain high-quality data management.

Apply and respect all company compliance standards, including security regulations, embargoed countries, carriers and restricted goods.

About our client

Our client is a leading international player in the transport and logistics sector, with a strong global network and expertise in air, sea, road and rail freight.

The company is committed to providing reliable, efficient and high-quality logistics solutions, ensuring that supply chains run smoothly worldwide.

With a strong focus on operational excellence, innovation and continuous improvement, our client encourages employees to take initiative, develop their skills and contribute to the company's ongoing growth.

You will join an international and dynamic environment where teamwork, customer satisfaction and professional development are key priorities.

First experience in Freight Forwarding, preferably in Air Freight.

Good command of Dutch or French and English.

Able to quickly learn and work with new IT systems.

Available to work a fixed late shift from 14:00 to 22:12.

All these requirements are important for this Freight Forwarder vacancy in Machelen.

Above all, our client is looking for someone who feels comfortable in a dynamic and international working environment, enjoys taking initiative, is eager to learn and is motivated to grow professionally.

If you are someone who likes to take on challenges, shows initiative and wants to develop your career in logistics, this could be the perfect opportunity for you!

What will you do?

• Weld and bond plastic and PVC components.
• Assemble custom-made plastic structures and stainless steel components.
• Work with machinery, hand tools and various assembly techniques.
• Carry out assembly and repair work on site.
• Handle plastic components up to 12 metres long.
• Work in a production environment, both independently and as part of a team.
• Carefully follow quality requirements and instructions.
• Travel to customer sites to carry out repairs, maintenance or installations.

Who are you?

• You have a technical background and knowledge of equipment or tools.
• You are motivated, eager to learn and willing to master new techniques.
• You have an eye for quality and a hands-on approach.
• Welding experience is an advantage.
• Physical work is not a problem for you.
• You have a good command of Dutch, French or English.

What you will do

Reporting to the Finance Manager, you join a small, collaborative team. The job is diverse and puts you in regular contact with other departments.

Day-to-day bookkeeping: booking incoming and outgoing payments and matching them against bank statements.

Billing and credit control: issuing customer invoices, monitoring open receivables and following up onoverdue payments.

Reporting: gathering figures for regular profitability and performance reporting.

Account reconciliations: carrying out monthly and year-end reconciliations of customer and supplier accounts.

Supplier invoice control: checking and approving incoming invoices from operational and general suppliers, in close contact with the operations team.
 
Your profile

• First experience in accounting (min. 2 years), either in a company or at an accounting office
• Fluent in Dutch and English
• Degree in accounting or a related field
• Knowledge of the logistics or transport sector is an asset, but not a requirement 
What we offer

• Attractive salary package (3500€-4000€ gross per month) with extralegal benefits such as meal vouchers, group insurance and more
• Full-time position with extra leave days on top of the legal holidays
• Possibility to work from home (1 day/week)
• Office within easy reach by public transport; available parking spot if needed
• The chance to be part of a growing organisation at an exciting stage of its development

Willing to learn and adopt new tools and practices.Customer-Centric Attitude: focused on delivering a smooth and reliable user experience. Understands the impact of endpoint performance on employee productivity.

Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is a subsidiary of Safran Aircraft Engines, based at Brussels Airport (Zaventem & Steenokkerzeel, Belgium), specialized in the inspection, maintenance and repair (MRO) of the advanced LEAP jet engines that power the latest generation of the Airbus A320NEO & Boeing B737MAX narrow body families. The company is a key player in the integrated CFM international MRO network. With more than 75 years of experience, and up to 20 international Part 145 certifications (EASA/ FAA/ CAAC/ …), Safran Aircraft Engine Services Brussels is recognized as a worldwide center of expertise in the air transport industry. More than a 100 airlines, lessors, private aircraft operators and MRO partners have entrusted their engines to our company. We employ over 600 highly skilled, passionate and enthusiastic employees.

To strengthen our Accounts Team we are looking for a Customer Operations Manager (Jet Engines):The Customer Operations Manager leads the Shop Visit Managers and administrators within the Accounts team. This team consolidates the factory-wide operational status and plays a key role in ensuring transparent communication, coordination, and escalation management to support the efficient execution of engine shop visits.The Customer Operations Manager and his/her team are also responsible for the relationship, communication, and shop visit coordination with our external customers (airlines). He/she acts as the main point of contact for new customer onboarding, the management of complaints and disputes, and any other customer-related matters. He/she represents the customer and their contractual constraints internally within the shop.Your role:

• Lead and coordinate a team of Shop Visit Managers (engine owners), fostering performance, collaboration, and professional development.
• Oversee the work-in-progress status of all engine projects, ensuring adherence to commitments, schedules, and customer requirements.
• Act as the key interface between Operations, Planning, Supply Chain, Quality, and the customer, ensuring clear communication and accurate reporting on project status and progress.
• Manage customer contractual constraints within the SAESB engine shop.
• Host customer visits, providing visibility on shop performance and ensuring a positive customer experience.*Lead strategic projects aimed at improving engine induction and delivery processes.
• Drive continuous improvement initiatives by analyzing operational performance and customer feedback, with the goal of enhancing volume output and efficiency.

Your profile:
 
 

• You hold a master's degree in engineering with a strong business affinity, or a degree in Business/Economics with a strong technical affinity or equivalent by experience. 

• You have strong business acumen and a results-driven mindset. 

• Experience in the aerospace or aeronautical industry is considered a strong asset. 

• You have at least 3 years of proven people management experience. 

• You are an excellent communicator and are fluent in English. Good knowledge of Dutch and French is a strong asset. 

• You possess strong interpersonal, stakeholder management, and representational skills. 

• You have a strong customer-oriented mindset.  

Candidates must be legally authorized to work in Belgium, holding either an EU passport or a valid work & residence permit. Please note that we do not provide assistance with visa or permit applications.

jobs.occupation: Coordinator Internal Sales | Brecht | Vast Contract
jobs.description:
Internal Sales Coördinator 

Are you an experienced people manager who enjoys bringing structure to a fast-paced operational environment? Do you combine strong leadership skills with a hands-on approach to order management, backlog management and customer service?

For an international and dynamic organization, I am looking for an Internal Sales Coördinator to lead a team of four employees.
In this role, you will be close to both the people and the operation. You will coach and develop your team, set priorities, monitor performance and ensure that customers and internal stakeholders receive clear and timely follow-up.

Your responsibilities 

 
• Lead, organize, motivate and coach a team of 4 employees on a daily basis. 
 
• Oversee order and backlog management and ensure customer service enquiries are handled efficiently. 
 
• Set priorities and distribute the workload evenly across the team. 
 
• Monitor team performance, operational metrics and KPIs, and take action where needed. 
 
• Identify training and development needs and provide ongoing coaching. 
 
• Conduct regular one-to-one meetings and performance evaluations. 
 
• Listen to team members' feedback and support them in resolving challenges or conflicts. 
 
• Create sufficient space for team members to contribute to improvement projects alongside their daily responsibilities. 
 
• Work closely with internal stakeholders to resolve escalations and ensure clear communication regarding priorities, progress and expected deliverables. 
 
• Provide management with feedback on operational challenges and identify opportunities for continuous improvement. 
 
• Contribute to a positive and collaborative working environment and organize team-building activities. 

Who are we looking for?
For this position, I am looking for someone who knows how to lead and develop people while maintaining a strong overview of the operational priorities. 

 
• You have several years of experience in a leadership or coordinating position, ideally within sales operations, order management or customer service. 
 
• You have proven people management experience and enjoy coaching, motivating and developing team members. 
 
• You have experience with backlog management and are strong at setting priorities and maintaining overview. 
 
• You are an excellent coordinator and communicator who can effectively manage expectations with different stakeholders. 
 
• You are comfortable monitoring KPIs and using them to drive team performance. 
 
• You have strong organizational, analytical and problem-solving skills. 
 
• You remain calm and effective in a dynamic environment and know how to manage competing priorities. 
 
• You are comfortable working both independently and collaboratively. 
 
• You have solid computer skills, including experience with Microsoft Office, CRM systems and SAP. 
 
• You are fluent in English. Additional languages are an asset, but not a requirement. 
 
• Experience with data modelling and data management tools is considered an advantage. 
 
• You can depend on your own transportation, as the workplace is not accessible by public transport.

Already living in Belgium in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges, and looking for a stable logistics job?

Do you enjoy physical work? Do you have experience in a warehouse or logistics environment? And are you comfortable working in a cold environment? Then this could be your next long-term opportunity!

For a leading logistics company in Oostkamp, we are looking for motivated warehouse workers to join the team. You will help distribute frozen food products to supermarkets across Belgium and Europe while working in a modern logistics environment where English is fully accepted.

Your role

As a warehouse worker, you are an important part of the logistics process. Using an electric pallet truck (EPT), you help ensure that products are received, stored and shipped correctly.

Your responsibilities include:

• Loading and unloading trucks
• Performing quality checks on incoming and outgoing goods
• Keeping the warehouse organised and safe
After a while, you can also receive internal reach truck training and expand your responsibilities.

You're a good fit if you:

• Have previous experience in warehouse or logistics
• Have experience with an electric pallet truck (EPT)
• Can work in a 2-shift system
• Aren't afraid of working in cold environments
• Have your own transportation to the company (no public transport nearby)
So please don't hesitate to apply if you meet these requirements!

Reach truck experience is a big plus but not mandatory.

 

!! Please note: you do NOT qualify if you're not already living in Belgium (in the area of Oostkamp-Bruges) and don't have legal permission to work in the country !!

jobs.occupation: Night CE truck driver for live poultry transport
jobs.description:
Job description 

As a vital link in our transport team, you safely collect and deliver poultry while the world sleeps. You will enjoy quiet, traffic-free roads throughout your shift, moving between different locations from Sunday evening to Friday morning. Using your forklift, you handle the loading and unloading of containers with care and precision. This role offers you true independence and responsibility as you manage one to three transport runs each night, ensuring everything is ready for your colleagues when your shift ends.

You will experience the freedom of night driving in a supportive, family-like environment where your contributions are truly valued. Your daily work is diverse, keeping you active and engaged while you take pride in maintaining your truck in top condition. If you appreciate a peaceful workspace without the rush-hour stress, this position is a perfect fit. We look forward to welcoming you to our team, where your professional work ethic makes a real difference in our daily operations.

 Requirements 

    
• Maintain a responsible and professional attitude while driving.
    
• Comfortable working in an environment with industry-related odours.
    
• Experience operating a truck-mounted forklift (kooiaap) is a strong advantage.
    
• Effective communication skills in Dutch, English, or French.
